comment: Sanctioned full<->lite boundary deltas, pinned exactly and TYPED. Every pin declares its kind and is validated against that kind's constraints by scripts/check-policy-consistency.sh - a pin outside its kind's shape fails, so this list cannot be used to wave through a semantic boundary change. Kinds: citation-repoint (the lite bake ships without ROLES.md, so *_ref citations re-point off ROLES.md) (the only kind still in use; the former path-vocabulary kind is retired - both weights now speak record ids, so no *_path -> *_record_id pin remains). Any NEW difference, any stale pin, and any full-set role absent from lite without a lite_omissions declaration fails the check. Adding an entry anywhere in this file is a boundary-projection decision, reviewed like one.

exceptions.lite: "lead may not authorize the green path; reserved merges route to the operator"

lite_omissions.reason: strategic stub, not yet operational - no lite distillation exists
